title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
summary: OpenAI has reportedly raised an additional $11 billion as part of a funding round that hasn't closed yet but is expected to in the coming weeks.
title_es: OpenAI recauda $11 mil millones a valuación de $1.25 billones
bajada: OpenAI completó una nueva ronda de financiamiento de $11 mil millones, alcanzando una valuación de $1.25 billones, consolidándose como una de las empresas más valiosas del mundo. Esta ronda refleja la confianza continua de inversores en el desarrollo de IA avanzada.
bajada_en: OpenAI completed a new funding round of $11 billion, reaching a $1.25 trillion valuation and becoming one of the world's most valuable companies. The round reflects sustained investor confidence in advanced AI development.

title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO
summary: OpenAI is now valued at $1.25 trillion in a new round of funding that has raised another $11 billion, according to Bloomberg. That would make it one of the world's most valuable companies, not long after raising $122 billion from investors in March at a valuation of $852 billion. Echoing FT and Wall Street Journal […]
title_es: Anthropic inicia roadshow para su IPO la próxima semana
bajada: Anthropic avanza con su oferta pública inicial (IPO), iniciando presentaciones formales a inversores la próxima semana. El movimiento marca un hito importante en la consolidación de la empresa como rival directo de OpenAI.
bajada_en: Anthropic is proceeding with its IPO roadshow next week, formally marketing to potential investors. The move marks a significant milestone as the company solidifies its position as a direct OpenAI competitor.

title: OpenAI Expected to Brief Investors Next Week After Raising $11 Billion
summary: OpenAI is expected to host a call with investors next week to discuss its third-quarter results, according to a person familiar with the plan. The discussions follow the close of the first part of its latest round, which raised $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation before the ...
title_es: Meta lanza Spaces para colaboración con agentes Muse
bajada: Meta introdujo Spaces, una nueva característica que permite crear experiencias personalizadas estilo aplicación dentro del asistente Muse. Los usuarios pueden construir hubs de compras, dashboards escolares, rastreadores de música y más.
bajada_en: Meta introduced Spaces, a new feature enabling personalized app-like experiences within its Muse AI assistant. Users can build shopping hubs, school dashboards, music trackers, and more directly in the app.

title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
summary: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.
title_es: OpenAI presenta BioBasicsBench para evaluar agentes en laboratorios
bajada: OpenAI lanzó BioBasicsBench, un benchmark de 100 tareas que mide la capacidad de agentes IA para interpretar datos experimentales y ejecutar tareas de laboratorio. Es un paso importante en la evaluación de IA para investigación científica.
bajada_en: OpenAI released BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring AI agents' ability to interpret experimental data and perform wet-lab science tasks. It's a significant step in evaluating AI for scientific research.

title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
summary: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
title_es: Modelos chinos DeepSeek y GLM alcanzan habilidades avanzadas en ciberseguridad
bajada: Experimentos muestran que modelos IA chinos como DeepSeek y GLM han desarrollado capacidades de hacking comparables a los modelos más avanzados de OpenAI. El resultado resalta la aceleración del desarrollo de IA a nivel global.
bajada_en: Experiments show that Chinese AI models like DeepSeek and GLM have developed hacking capabilities comparable to OpenAI's most advanced models. The finding highlights accelerating global AI development.

title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
summary: Meta will now allow you to build customized, app-like experiences within Muse. The new feature, called "spaces," allows its AI assistant to build things like a shopping hub, school dashboard, music tracker, trivia game, and more, which you can interact with directly in the Muse app. Meta says you can create a new space by […]
title_es: Perplexity lanza agentes IA para trabajo en equipo
bajada: Perplexity anunció el lanzamiento de agentes especializados para tareas complejas y recurrentes, permitiendo a equipos delegar trabajo a asistentes IA. La herramienta se posiciona como solución para aumentar productividad empresarial.
bajada_en: Perplexity launched AI agents designed for complex and ongoing work tasks, enabling teams to delegate to specialized assistants. The tool targets enterprise productivity.

title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
summary: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.
title_es: Higgs Realtime Duplex: modelo full-duplex de 45B parámetros
bajada: Boson AI presentó Higgs Realtime Duplex, un modelo MoE de 45 mil millones de parámetros que procesa audio, video y texto simultáneamente con latencia baja. El modelo permite interacción natural sin turnos alternativos.
bajada_en: Boson AI revealed Higgs Realtime Duplex, a 45B parameter MoE model processing audio, video, and text simultaneously with low latency. It enables natural interaction without alternating turns.

title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
summary: A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software, joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development. Together, they give researchers a foundation for testing ideas, comparing results and building on each other’s work — connecting simulation and AI training with experiments on real over-the-air wireless […]
title_es: Chainalysis sufrió robo de credenciales de todos sus clientes
bajada: Chainalysis reportó que hackers robaron credenciales y tokens de todos sus clientes durante un ciberataque multi-frontal que incluyó agentes IA. El incidente subraya vulnerabilidades en infraestructura crítica de seguridad blockchain.
bajada_en: Chainalysis reported that hackers stole credentials and tokens from all its customers during a multi-front cyberattack involving AI agents. The breach highlights vulnerabilities in critical blockchain security infrastructure.

title_es: OpenAI se asocia con Hacktron para pruebas de seguridad
bajada: OpenAI anunció una asociación con Hacktron para identificar vulnerabilidades en sus sistemas y reforzar defensas. La iniciativa busca fortalecer la seguridad de los modelos de IA frontera.
bajada_en: OpenAI partnered with Hacktron to identify vulnerabilities and strengthen system defenses. The initiative aims to enhance security for frontier AI models.

title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
summary: An experiment in which AI models were asked to break into simulated networks showed the hacking skills of DeepSeek and GLM to be not far behind OpenAI’s most advanced cyber model, which isn’t public.
title_es: NVIDIA abre herramientas para desarrollo de redes 6G
bajada: NVIDIA continúa con su iniciativa open source para telecomunicaciones, ofreciendo herramientas como Aerial y Sionna para acelerar investigación en 6G. Los recursos facilitan pruebas, comparación de resultados y colaboración entre investigadores.
bajada_en: NVIDIA continues its open-source telco initiative, providing tools like Aerial and Sionna to accelerate 6G research. Resources enable testing, result comparison, and researcher collaboration.

title: Perplexity launches AI agents for work
title_es: ToyBlocks: entorno controlado para aprendizaje de robots
bajada: Allen AI y Hugging Face presentaron ToyBlocks, un entorno simulado para entrenar y evaluar agentes robóticos en tareas controladas. La herramienta facilita la investigación en robótica y aprendizaje por refuerzo.
bajada_en: Allen AI and Hugging Face presented ToyBlocks, a simulated environment for training and evaluating robotic agents in controlled tasks. The tool accelerates robotics and reinforcement learning research.

title: Higgs Realtime Duplex: a 45B MoE full-duplex model that listens, watches and talks at once, and thinks, calls tools and delegates in the background [N]
summary: Disclosure: I'm at Boson AI and this is our release. Not open weights; the Duplex API has a waitlist, and the previous turn-based Higgs Realtime is available now.Most voice models are still turn-based: listen, wait for end of turn, think, speak. Duplex runs all streams at once and keeps working in the background while it talks.Streams.Everything is cut into 160 ms chunks:Audio in: 1 token per chunk (6.25 tokens/s)Audio out: 2 tokens per chunk (12.5 tokens/s)Video in: one ~12-token camera frame every 6 chunksFace out: 2 latents per chunkText in and out alongsideSilence is represented as chunks too, which is what the model uses to decide when to backchannel, interrupt or stay quiet. That comes to ~2.6K tokens per minute for audio and video, 2.6K to 5K with thinking and tool traces (progressively compacted). The last 5 minutes plus compacted text history is 13K to 25K tokens; older history is kept as text.Background work.Thinking, tool calls and delegation are spans in the same stream and can cover many chunks. Tool results can arrive in stages and the model can start speaking before they are complete. Harder problems are delegated to a much larger backend model with the full shared context. This is the main difference from Thinking Machines' interaction models, where all reasoning and tool use goes to the background model, which can mean 10+ seconds per answer and makes cost harder to control.Voice and face.Set zero-shot at deployment: a short reference clip for the voice, one image for the face, and a text prompt for behavior. No fine-tuning. Audio comes from a causal flow-matching decoder (2 frames per chunk), the face from a causal DiT conditioned on the reference image and the previous two latents.Training.Starts from a text-pretrained LLM, continued pretraining on ~2T tokens of text, audio and video on our own H100 cluster (Megatron-based stack). title_es: Cientos de herramientas Artex de hacking expuestas públicamente
bajada: Investigadores de seguridad descubrieron cientos de servidores con la herramienta Artex de pentesting expuesta en internet sin protección. El hallazgo plantea riesgos de acceso no autorizado a herramientas de pruebas de penetración.
bajada_en: Security researchers discovered hundreds of servers hosting the penetration testing tool Artex exposed to the internet without protection. The finding raises concerns about unauthorized access to hacking tools.
